cases.prompt: Set up Karma for my Jasmine tests to run in headless Chrome in CI with coverage.
expectations: Shows karma.conf.js with frameworks, files and browsers.
Adds coverage preprocessing and a coverage reporter.

cases.prompt: Karma tests hang in our Docker CI container when Chrome starts. Fix?
expectations: Defines a custom launcher based on ChromeHeadless with --no-sandbox.
Explains Chrome sandboxing fails as root in containers.
Mentions increasing captureTimeout or browserNoActivityTimeout if needed.
